events.title: Rush Your Band Demo — Co-op Issues, Actively Working On It
events.summary: Hey! Wanted to give a heads up on where things stand.Co-op might be a bit rough right now — running into some issues there and I know it. I'm deep in fixing it, so bear with me for a bit.On the plus side: most other bugs are squashed, and the recording system specifically got a proper fix. Also chipping away at optimization on the side.Appreciate the patience, more updates soon!

events.title: Rush Your Band Demo — Bugs Squashed, Recording Fixed
events.summary: Hey! Quick update on how things are going.Fixed most of the bugs that piled up over the last while. Spent a good chunk of time digging into the recording system specifically — there was an issue where the audio could start looping on itself mid-take. That's sorted now, recording works the way it should.Still working on: optimization (grinding on it) and co-op — I want to get it into a proper state, it's not as smooth as I'd like yet.Also, female characters for customization might be coming soon

events.title: Rush Your Band Demo — Update: Major Bugs Fixed
events.summary: Hey everyone,Quick follow-up on the earlier note — most of the game-breaking bugs have now been fixed.Sorry again for the rough launch. Thanks for sticking around.Let me know if you run into anything else.

events.title: Rush Your Band Demo — Quick Note
events.summary: Hey everyone, Thanks for trying the demo. I know there are some bugs in there right now — sorry about that. This is a solo project and things slipped through before launch.I'm on it and fixing things as fast as I can. Appreciate you sticking with it in the meantime.More soon.

events.title: Rush Your Band — Demo drops tomorrow
events.summary: Hey everyone,Tomorrow the demo goes live, and I wanted to share a bit of why this game exists before that happens.I've been connected to music since I was a kid — never as a real artist, more as someone who always loved it from the side. At some point I realized I'd probably never actually live that experience myself: stepping up to a mic, dropping a track, watching people react to something you made.
